**698 of 700 tests passed. Two failed, both in `auth/tokens.test.js`.**

- `refreshToken silently accepts an already-revoked token` — `auth/tokens.test.js:400`
- `sessionCleanup leaves orphaned rows after a rollback` — `auth/tokens.test.js:650`

Nothing else in the log went wrong. No skips, no errors, no crash at the end.

Both failures sit in the same file, so one change may well cover both. The first one lets a revoked token still work, which is worth looking at first.
